entities.summary: John Stewart Rock was an African American teacher, doctor, dentist, lawyer and abolitionist, historically associated with the concept that "black is beautiful", which was thought to have originated from a speech he made in 1858. Historical records now indicate he never actually used the specific phrase on that day, although he did refer to the beauty of Black people. John Rock was a legal figures from Salem (1825-10-13, Salem–1866-12-03). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
